title: What Problems Can Artist Publishers Solve?
comment: This publication is the 118th booklet produced by Temporary Services. In collaboration with PrintRoom, they invited 17 artists-publishers to contribute responses to the question: Thinking locally, regionally, nationally, and internationally: What are some social, political, economic and ecological problems that artist publishers are equipped to address or solve using their knowledge, skills, and resources?
